========================================
Nested call arguments in body stay calls
========================================

void f(void) {
    foo(x(y), z);
    assert(x(y) >= z);
    m(g(a) + b);
}

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (primitive_type))))
    (compound_statement
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          (identifier)
          (argument_list
            (call_expression
              (identifier)
              (argument_list
                (identifier)))
            (identifier))))
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          (identifier)
          (argument_list
            (binary_expression
              (call_expression
                (identifier)
                (argument_list
                  (identifier)))
              (identifier)))))
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          (identifier)
          (argument_list
            (binary_expression
              (call_expression
                (identifier)
                (argument_list
                  (identifier)))
              (identifier))))))))
